name: Model Turnkey: Qwen3.6-27B NVFP4 Vision (1x RTX 5090)
readme: Qualified vision-enabled profile for nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 on 1x GeForce RTX 5090 32 GB. It downloads about 21 GiB and defaults to 192K context, compiled MTP-off decoding, FP8 KV, and an 8.39M-pixel native-vision cap. The full API feature suite, a 192,290-token five-depth retrieval, and two detailed 5120x2880 vision gates passed on Vast. Ports 1111 and 8000 use Runpod managed HTTPS for the dashboard and secure API fallback. In a private clone, add DESEC_TOKEN and DESEC_DOMAIN through Runpod Secrets to make port 8443 a direct appliance-TLS route that avoids Runpod proxy's 100-second limit.
